The strongest signal is **emailservice**: from 20:47 to 20:51 its open sockets rise from 5.7 to 10 while memory grows from 44.2 MB to 130.4 MB. During this period, checkoutservice logs “no healthy upstream” when sending order confirmations. This points to an emailservice socket/connection buildup; the telemetry does not establish that sockets are fully exhausted. The Jaeger export deadline warning may be related, but does not by itself explain the checkout failures.
